newsitem.title: USA: Coastal Physician names Scott chairman.
newsitem.headline: Coastal Physician names Scott chairman.

text.p: Coastal Physician Group Inc said Tuesday it named Steven Scott chairman, effectively immediately.

It said Scott, Coastal's founder and largest shareholder, will work closely with Smith Barney Inc, the company's new investment banking firm, to evaluate strategic alternatives to maximize shareholder value.
Morgan Stanley previously served as an adviser to the firm.

"The board believes that Dr. Scott can assist the company as we continue to move through the investment banking and strategic planning process," said Henry Murphy, Coastal's president and chief executive. "This action also enables our executive management team to focus on financial and operating issues," Murphy said.

Scott had served as Coastal's chief executive office until May. Scott, also a director of Coastal, then launched a widely publicized proxy battle to regain control of the company's board of directors.
Coastal also said Jacque Sokolov was named vice chairman.
Coastal was not immediately available to comment on whom Scott and Sokolov replace.
